title: AI-Assisted Requirements Prioritization: Spotify Playlist Case Study
shortDescription: Explore Spotify playlist features, correct two Python functions, compare release plans, and review an AI recommendation.
learningOutcomes: Find software requirements in Spotify's playlist documentation.
Test playlist features and identify a setting that needs to be corrected.
Calculate requirement priorities and choose features within a development budget.
Compare an AI recommendation with the Python results and Spotify's API rules.

courseAlignment.evidence: Students analyze official API requirements, sources, limitations, and LLM-generated suggestions.
Students implement an API policy constraint, apply utility analysis, and justify a bounded release.
Students interpret ranked utilities, optimization outputs, budget sensitivity, and AI-versus-human disagreements.

tasks.title: Read the Spotify requirements
tasks.description: Open Spotify Case, read D1–D4, and record two rules in Report section 1.

tasks.title: Test the playlist features
tasks.description: Rename a playlist, add and remove songs, and try FR-06. Write what happened in Report section 2.

tasks.title: Run the starting code
tasks.description: Run main.py and check which features were selected in Spotify Case.

tasks.title: Fix the playlist rule
tasks.description: Update playlist_policy_ok() so public and collaborative cannot both be true. Run the code again.

tasks.title: Calculate feature priority
tasks.description: Update requirement_utility() using the three stakeholder ratings. Check FR-01 and the 8-day release.

tasks.title: Ask ChatGPT or Gemini
tasks.description: Copy the case prompt from Spotify Case and compare the AI recommendation with Python.

tasks.title: Check your results
tasks.description: Enter the AI ranking, test a 6-day budget, restore 8 days, and run Verify Requirements.

tasks.title: Complete your report
tasks.description: Answer the six report questions, enter your name and student ID, and submit.
